title: Paid Holidays

eligibility.who: All employees: 6 Costa Rican public holidays plus 7 floating days; no more than 1 paid holiday per 30 days; 4 days' notice

text:
It Company observes the following Costa Rican public holidays:
- New Year's Day (January 1)
- Juan Santamaría Day (April 11)
- Labour Day (May 1)
- Guanacaste Day (July 25)
- Independence Day (September 15)
- Christmas Day (December 25)
If employee is required/wishes to work on a paid holiday, they will have an option to take another paid day off.
Floating Holidays
Employees will also have 7 (seven) additional floating holidays that can be requested to celebrate any other public or personal holiday on employee's discretion.
No more than 1 paid holiday days off can be taken in 30-days period.
Four (4) days’ notice is required before working on a paid holiday/taking paid days off.
If the Holiday falls on Saturday or Sunday, it will be observed the following Monday.
If a holiday falls within an eligible employee's approved vacation period, employee will be paid for the holiday (at the regular straight-time rate) in addition to the vacation day.
